name: Linn breeze pocket
desc: Breezy AkaiLinn pocket for city pop: soft kick on 1 and the and-of-three, sidestick on 2&4 opening into full snare at peak, 8th hats with gentle accents and an open-hat lift into each new bar. Convertible-on-the-wangan drums.

gain.doc: kick level, other layers scale from it

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${gain}).shape(.18), s("~ rim ~ rim").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${gain}*.55).room(.28), s("hh*8").bank("AkaiLinn").gain("[.4 .2]*4").pan(cosine.range(.45,.6).slow(10)), s("[~ ~ ~ oh]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${breeze}).lpf(7000).pan(.6), s("sd*16").bank("AkaiLinn").degradeBy(.9).gain(.14).pan(.42)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] [bd ~]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${gain}).shape(.22), s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${gain}*.58).room(.3), s("hh*8").bank("AkaiLinn").gain("[.44 .24]*4").pan(cosine.range(.4,.62).slow(8)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)), s("[~ ~ ~ oh]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${breeze}*1.3).lpf(8000).pan(.62), s("sd*16").bank("AkaiLinn").degradeBy(.85).gain(.16).pan(.4), s("cr ~ ~ ~").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(.24).mask("<1 0 0 0>")).orbit(1).play()
